digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler apply-differ seam, comment dedup logic
propositions: A new seam-crossing test posts a real comment via _record_comment_id against a real BindingStore instance, then re-diffs with _diff_comments against that same store to verify the recorded comment is skipped while an unrecorded control comment is still emitted.

The test uses a real envelope fixture obtained through stubbed acli_cli_ops.add_comment and _run_acli, with Jira-side body divergence ensuring the secondary body-equality skip does not mask an inert primary id-identity skip.

An inert-guard variant monkeypatches the store instance's is_comment_mapped to always return False and verifies the recorded comment is re-emitted, proving the seam assertion discriminates on the guard rather than passing vacuously.
